neighbours.label: A short list of fixed compound names rather than one pattern: ' Crew' in NASA's 'Commercial Crew' (strongest), ' standing' in 'standing desk', 'SEC' in 'DNSSEC'
fire: Two companies were chosen by NASA for the next round of Commercial Crew flights.
The capsule was built with funding from the agency's Commercial Crew contracts.
Delays in the Commercial Crew schedule forced NASA to buy more Soyuz seats.
Astronauts assigned to Commercial Crew missions trained in Houston all winter.
After months of back pain she finally ordered a standing desk for the study.
The company gives each new engineer a standing desk and two monitors.
Our provider finally turned on DNSSEC for all customer zones.
Without DNSSEC a resolver cannot verify that the answer is authentic.
quiet: Two companies were chosen by NASA for the next round of cargo flights.
The capsule was built with funding from the agency's lunar lander contracts.
The film crew spent three weeks shooting scenes at the launch site.
The flight crew boarded the shuttle two hours before liftoff.
After months of back pain she finally ordered a wooden desk for the study.
The engineer was standing by the window with two colleagues.
Our provider finally turned on encryption for all customer zones.
Without a certificate a browser cannot verify that the site is authentic.

notes: Card shows no single token (SEC, standing, ban, Crew, Core, Streets). Probes: 'Commercial Crew' 0.70-0.76, 'standing desk' 0.20-0.33, 'DNSSEC' 0.21, 'Common Core' 0.17, 'travel ban' 0.03, 'Apollo Crew' 0.03, 'standing near' 0.03. I found no shared pattern, so this is a list and is registered as such.
